Gestures.Web.AutoStartDescription: Open MyGestures in the tray when you sign in.
Gestures.Web.Description: Hold the right mouse button and draw, then release to run the assigned action. Closing this window keeps gestures running in the system tray.
Gestures.Web.EnableDescription: Listen for right-button gestures on this computer.
Gestures.Web.GameModeDescription: Pause gestures while another app is fullscreen, so games and videos keep the right mouse button.
Gestures.Web.LanguageDescription: Language for the settings window and gesture trail.
Gestures.Web.ThemeDescription: Choose a light or dark appearance.
Gestures.Web.Timeout: The operation timed out. Try again.
Gestures.Web.UpdateBusy: An update operation is already running.
Gestures.Web.UpdateFailed: The update check failed. Try again.
Gestures.Web.UpdateIdle: Check GitHub for a newer installer or apply an installed update.
Gestures.Web.UpdateLatest: You are using the latest version ({{version}}).
Gestures.Web.UpdateNotInstalled: In-app updates are available after installing the setup package.
Plugin.Settings.Gestures.ClickToRecord: Click to record in the target app
Plugin.Settings.Gestures.ConflictLose: Conflicts with "{{name}}", which will take priority.
Plugin.Settings.Gestures.ConflictWins: Conflicts with "{{name}}". This one takes priority.
Plugin.Settings.Gestures.HeaderActionTip: The name of this gesture action.
Plugin.Settings.Gestures.HeaderGestureTi: Click to record. Settings hide so you can click the target app, then hold the right mouse button and draw.
Plugin.Settings.Gestures.HeaderProcessTi: Only trigger this gesture in the specified processes. Recording a gesture fills this from the window you click. Leave empty to apply to all processes.
Plugin.Settings.Gestures.HeaderTriggerTi: The action to run. Click to choose a keyboard shortcut or mouse button.
Plugin.Settings.Gestures.RecordHintIntro: Settings will hide so you can switch to the app you want.
Plugin.Settings.Gestures.RecordHintStepC: Click the application window this gesture should apply to.
Plugin.Settings.Gestures.RecordHintStepD: Hold the right mouse button and draw the gesture.
Plugin.Settings.Gestures.RecordHintStepR: Release the right mouse button to return here. The gesture and target process will be filled in.
Plugin.Settings.Gestures.Recording: Click the target app, then hold the right mouse button and draw.
